(Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy missing: COEP would block opt-in remote images in email bodies; COOP and CORP are set)

(CSP notes: img-src allows https: so a reader can opt in to remote images in a message, and style-src allows inline styles because HTML email relies on style blocks and React sets style attributes; script-src is strict 'self' with no inline or eval. Unit tests in tests/security.test.ts pin the full policy, so a regression fails CI there)
